title: Recovery plan — sign-ups
question: How do we get the live sign-ups KR back on track?

frame.problem: Sign-up page conversion fell from 26% to 18% after the offer change and the live sign-ups KR is red. What do we change to get back on track before Live #1?

vars.name: Speed of effect
vars.ctx: Live #1 is in 2 weeks. A fix that needs a new page or new traffic arrives too late.

vars.name: Effort
vars.ctx: Michael is at 97% load; the fix must fit in a few hours.

vars.name: Risk to the launch date
vars.ctx: Moving the date resets partner promotion and the sales calendar.

opts.name: Remove the price from the sign-up page
opts.desc: Keep the free sign-up free of any price signal; the price appears after the live.

opts.name: Move Live #1 to Oct 29
opts.desc: Two more weeks of acquisition at the current conversion.

opts.name: Partner co-promotion
opts.desc: Ask the 3 partner communities to push the live this week.
